[[M Tigers F.C.|PJ Stars Kings]] | matches = | total goals = | prevseason = [[2005–06 National First Division|2005–06]] | nextseason = [[2007–08 National First Division|2007–08]] }} The '''2006–07 National First Division''' (known as the '''Mvela Golden League''' for sponsorship reasons) was the 11th season of the [[National First Division]], the second tier of South African [[Association football|soccer]]. The champions were [[Free State Stars F.C.|Free State Stars]], who finished eighteen points ahead of their nearest rivals, and were promoted to the [[South African Premier Division]].{{Cite web |title=Ready to take PSL by storm |url=https://www.sowetanlive.co.za/news/2007-05-11-ready-to-take-psl-by-storm/ |access-date=2023-07-25 |website=SowetanLIVE |language=en-ZA}}{{Cite web |title=Premier Soccer League - www.psl.co.za - official website |url=https://www.psl.co.za/content/16306 |access-date=2023-07-25 |website=www.psl.co.za}} ==Points deductions== [[M Tigers F.C.|PJ Stars Kings]] were deducted 15 points by [[South African Football Association|SAFA]] for using unregistered players, and as a result suffered relegation to the [[SAFA Second Division]].
